Name: 4FACTORS Egyptian Q&A Sample
Description: Native-written Egyptian Arabic conversational question-answer pairs (50) with English glosses and domain labels; written by a first-language Egyptian speaker and reviewed for personal data, copyright and linguistic diversity. No scraping, machine translation, or synthetic generation.
Abstract: A public demonstration sample of 50 native-written question-answer pairs in spoken (colloquial) Egyptian Arabic, each with an English gloss and a domain label. Written from scratch by a first-language Egyptian speaker under a brief that forbids copying, translating and AI generation, then passed through two documented review passes — one for personal data and copyright, one measured for linguistic diversity. Both pre- and post-review file versions are retained for auditable provenance. Part of a three-variety corpus (MSA, Palestinian Levantine, Egyptian) archived on Zenodo under DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21380048. Larger sets and other Arabic varieties are available on commission with full IP transfer.
